div.div:
Gaps (not drawn):
• Not drawn: a page classified non-medical at 90% or more, where the customer keeps or discards it (flows.md §Gate rules).
• Not drawn: a medical page at 90% or more, which goes straight to extraction without triage.
• Not drawn: the Compare view's second verdict run and the eval runner's runs (AD-11, AD-17).
• Not drawn: failure paths. A stage that misses its 180-second deadline stores a failed result (AD-6); what the user sees is not stated.
• Not drawn: a redaction that fails or passes its deadline. The case ends as failed and the customer uploads again (AD-21).
Each element's source is in grey under its name and in its tooltip.
